# The 24-hour window

WhatsApp lets a business send a free-form message (a text, buttons or media) to a person only within 24 hours of that person's last message to the same number. Each new message from them opens the window again.

Outside the window, or to someone who has not written before, only an approved template can be sent. get_conversation says whether the window is open and when it closes.

A scheduled text reaches the person only if the window is still open when it is sent. A template is not limited by the window.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/concepts#24-hour-window
